{{Quote|Surely you'll be sending them to our quadrant.''"''<br />''"''Really, we're key to the entire region.|The under-palatine for patriotic liaisons and his assistant try to convince Count Dooku to send reinforcements to Troxar|<ref name="YDR 1" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Troxan]] who served as the assistant to the [[under-palatine for patriotic liaisons]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During that conflict, this Troxan was part of a delegation from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troxar]] to visit [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] at [[Château Malreaux]], on the planet [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]], in a bid to win more support for the world's resistance to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] tried to convince Dooku that they were planning to surrender to the Republic unless more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] arrived in their [[Troxar system/Legends|system]]. Dooku used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince them to keep fighting, that reinforcements were on their way&mdash;but not to surrender. This was part of a bid by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to make Troxar a resource sink for the Republic.<ref name="YDR 1">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', Chapter 1.</ref>
